name: cliproxy
description: Register a CLIProxyAPI gateway (router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI) as an OpenAI-compatible model provider in Oh-My-Pi. You supply the gateway URL + API key; the installer lists the available models and writes a 'cliproxy' provider into ~/.omp/agent/models.yml with runtime model discovery, so any upstream the gateway exposes (Gemini/Codex/Claude/Grok via CLI accounts) is usable as cliproxy/<model-id>.
